dict.Adresă web → PDF merge doar în aplicația: Web address → PDF only works in the Cyber Office Studio app (not in the browser).
dict.O pagină de pe internet, după adresa ei: A page from the internet, by its address (https://…) → A4 PDF, with its pictures and colors; no scripts and no cookies
dict.Scrie adresa paginii (de exemplu https:/: Type the page address (for example https://example.com/article). The page is fetched with its pictures and colors, but without scripts and without cookies; pages that only show up with scripts may come out empty.
dict.Adresa nu e bună. Scrie-o întreagă, de e: The address is not valid. Type it in full, for example https://example.com/page.
